command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
p='parsing/html/reader.go'
s=open(p).read()
# Remove the misplaced block
bad='''		// Any other tag-like construct must begin with a letter to be a tag;
		// otherwise treat the '<' as literal text.
		if i+1 >= len(data) || !isAsciiLetter(data[i+1]) {
			tokens = append(tokens, token{typ: tokenText, text: "<"})
			i++
			continue
		}

		// end tag.
		if bytes.HasPrefix(data[i:], []byte("</")) {'''
good='''		// end tag.
		if bytes.HasPrefix(data[i:], []byte("</")) {'''
assert bad in s
s=s.replace(bad,good)
# Insert letter validation just before "// start tag."
old2='''		// start tag.
		end := bytes.IndexByte(data[i:], '>')'''
new2='''		// Any other tag-like construct must begin with a letter to be a tag;
		// otherwise treat the '<' as literal text.
		if i+1 >= len(data) || !isAsciiLetter(data[i+1]) {
			tokens = append(tokens, token{typ: tokenText, text: "<"})
			i++
			continue
		}

		// start tag.
		end := bytes.IndexByte(data[i:], '>')'''
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)
